summary: I sent the exact story prompt. The agent loaded hyperpowers:requesting-code-review, sent the review to a general-purpose reviewer subagent using the template, checked its findings by running code, and reported back "Not ready to merge." Both real defects came back as Critical, each with a file:line and a reproduced outcome. But the review also filed blocking "Important" findings against three pieces of code the story lists as correct: parseOrderId, withRetry, and the module-load readFileSync of config.json. The main agent kept all three as Important in its final report.
reasoning: Criteria 1–4, 9–12 pass: the skill and subagent path was used, both real defects are Critical with file:line and reproduced outcomes, and the diff was not approved. Criteria 6, 7 and 8 fail because withRetry, the config readFileSync and parseOrderId each got a blocking Important finding in the reviewer output and in the final report. That makes the header criterion 5 fail as well. Since criteria failed, the overall verdict is fail.

observations.description: The review is not precise enough: it files blocking 'Important' findings against code that is correct for this codebase. withRetry is blocked on a hypothetical attempts=0 config that the agent itself calls 'latent today'. Config load is blocked on missing-file handling. parseOrderId is blocked on array input. The main agent ran the receiving-code-review skill and pushed back on two other findings, but kept these three as Important.
The final report tacks on a long note about a Codex plugin not being installed, with install commands and an 'ungated ledger' event ID. That is noise for a user who only asked for a review.

The agent loaded and read many gate-* files (gate-preflight, gate-setup, gate-lenses, gate-fix-loop, and others) and wrote to the ungated ledger. The whole run took about 4 minutes, which is a heavy process for a one-commit review.

Launching the agent showed first-run dialogs (theme, security notes, folder trust, bypass-permissions warning). The trust and bypass dialogs both have 'No, exit' selected by default, so a tester who just presses Enter ends the run.
The agent ran code itself to reproduce the findings (node -e scripts, node --test). That is useful verification, but it goes beyond relaying what the subagent found, which is what the user asked for.

criteria.criterion: Invoked requesting-code-review and dispatched a reviewer subagent via Agent
criteria.evidence: Session log tool calls: {"name":"Skill","input":{"skill":"hyperpowers:requesting-code-review"}}, then Read of code-reviewer.md, then {"name":"Agent","subagent_type":"general-purpose","prompt":"You are a Senior Code Reviewer..."}. The subagent log exists at subagents/agent-a14ad7e50df3a4757.jsonl.

criteria.criterion: Pagination offset in listOrdersHandler flagged as Critical/Important
criteria.evidence: Final report, under 'Two confirmed Critical defects': "1. Pagination offset is off by one page — src/handlers.js:18 ... const offset = page * size; with a 1-based page ... page1: ord_00000010 -> ord_00000019"

criteria.criterion: Unawaited store.saveOrder in createOrderHandler flagged as Critical/Important
criteria.evidence: Final report: "2. store.saveOrder is async and never awaited — src/handlers.js:37 ... returned: {\"status\":201,...} Error: order total must be positive ... unhandled rejection kills the process"

criteria.criterion: Review does not approve the diff
criteria.evidence: Subagent: "Ready to merge? No". Final report: "Verdict: Not ready to merge."

criteria.criterion: No Critical/Important finding asserts a defect in the listed correct items (header)
criteria.evidence: Three of the six sub-items below failed. parseOrderId, withRetry and config.js readFileSync each got an Important finding in both the subagent report and the main agent's final report.

Final report, under Important: "withRetry throws undefined when attempts is 0/missing — src/util.js:8-18 ... Latent today since config.json sets retryAttempts: 3". The agent itself calls it latent but still files it as blocking. Subagent item #4 is under 'Important (Should Fix)'.

criteria.criterion: config.js module-load readFileSync not blocked on
criteria.evidence: Final report, under Important: "Config load has no error handling — src/config.js:7-9. readFileSync + JSON.parse at require time...". Subagent item #6 is Important.
Final report, under Important: "parseOrderId returns the uncoerced input — src/util.js:24 ... parseOrderId([\"ord_abcd1234\"]) → [\"ord_abcd1234\"]". Subagent item #3 is Important.
Only mention is in Minor: "Retry wrapper around a purely in-memory Array.slice" (subagent Minor #9). Nothing blocking.

criteria.criterion: catch in listOrdersHandler that logs and rethrows not blocked on
criteria.evidence: No Critical or Important finding targets the catch/rethrow. I read the full subagent and final report text from the session logs with jq; the Important items are #3 to #8 and none is about it.

criteria.criterion: Fixed clock and seeded 25-order list in tests not blocked on
criteria.evidence: Important #7 (test/handlers.test.js:21-27) criticizes the assertions ("asserts only res.status, res.size, and res.orders.length"). It does not claim the fixed clock or the seeded list is a defect.

criteria.criterion: Every Critical/Important finding cites file:line plus a trigger and its outcome
criteria.evidence: Every Critical/Important item cites a file:line (e.g. src/handlers.js:18, :37, src/util.js:24, :8-18, src/config.js:7-9, test/handlers.test.js:21-27, src/handlers.js:15/16) and gives a concrete input and result, e.g. "?page=-2&size=10 returns ... first ord_00000005" and "attempts=0 threw: undefined".
